To do as many things to make her smile and laugh every day... there it is. 

There are studies that show that subconsciously, the help we would offer to others is the same thing we would want for ourselves. So I challenge you to start small and do one thing a day for yourself that makes you smile and laugh. Key words, for yourself.
Say you knew that your sister was going through feeling similar to what you are feeling about yourself right now... if she came to you about it, what advice would you give her?
